CRITICAL product identity and scale:

Both on same level stone and same camera distance. Omega total height exactly59.6% of white total height; Omega body diameter90% of white body diameter. Omega reference1 has black ribbed cap, amber bottle, beige label with exact text 'Омега-3 / ПНЖК НСП / Omega-3 EPA NSP' and muted salmon orange band. Preserve this Russian packaging, NOT Ukrainian EPA label from an older scene. Cap roughly18% of Omega total height. Keep label typography crisp and legible. White label: 'Хлорофилл Жидкий / Liquid Chlorophyll', NATURES SUNSHINE logo, original mint-green label.
COMPOSITION MUST MATCH OUR WIDE WEBSITE HERO: panorama2.5:1, request native3840x1536. Preserve generous but restrained space ABOVE cap: white cap top is8% of photo height, white total height77%, shared bottle baseline85%. Omega total height45.9%, top39.1%, same baseline85%. This leaves a clean header-to-cap gap when the full panorama is shown, about45–55px on our1470px-wide screen. No UI or actual header in photograph.
Pair in right half: Omega center at60% width, white center72% width, close together with a small gap. All packaging entirely visible, NO cropping caps or bases. Labels frontal, camera level,85mm lens feel, parallel verticals, no wide angle perspective distortion.
Left42% is airy calm negative space for white glass copy card. Natural slender stem and delicate clean petals, no weird brown blotches. Sparse fern near lower stone and upper-right edge, all plants realistic, coherent stems, no doubled/melted leaves.
PALETTE: our design-system pale mint#eaf3f1, soft mint#9fdcc6, desaturated cool sage and restrained deep forest#1d3a36. Photography should harmonize with this palette; cool neutral white balance, no yellow/olive cast, no neon mint. Keep original packaging colors accurate. No text overlays, UI, frames, checkerboard, ribbons, extra bottles, watermarks. Highest native detail, genuinely4K if supported, do not mislabel a small image as4K.
